# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P8](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Agatha Sowerby's husband  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed is a quiet, small, and unusual-appearing man with an awkward frame. He has lengthy, iron-gray hair reaching his hunching shoulders, and a thick, gentle brown beard that he has worn continuously since the age of twenty.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Obed is extremely timid, quiet, and taciturn, despising being surrounded by unfamiliar people or visiting places where he might need to converse. He harbors a deep fear of women, excepting his sister Thirza and Mrs. Agatha Sowerby, feeling uneasy that they might be quietly mocking him. Despite his quiet bashfulness, he possesses a quiet, stubborn resolve once he fixes his heart on a particular desire, and he appreciates loquacious companions who handle conversation on their own. He has a gentle, sympathetic nature, possessing an empathetic soul and a deep aversion to inflicting hardship or disappointment on innocent beings.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P27](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0027), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c2 P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)_

## Goals

- Obtain a boy from an orphan asylum to assist him with farm labor as he grows older  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- Provide a comfortable home and schooling for orphan Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)</sub>

## History

Seeking help with farm chores due to advancing age and heart trouble, Obed arranged through Mrs. Alexander Tranter to adopt an orphan boy from Nova Scotia. Travelling to Alder River station, he unexpectedly received an orphan girl named Nell Harcourt instead. Unable to leave her behind, he brought her to Grey Shutters, enjoying her chatty company despite his bashfulness. Though Thirza initially insisted on returning Nell, Obed persistently advocated for keeping her. When Nell faced banishment to Mrs. Sowerby's after an outburst, Obed privately coaxed her into making amends to resolve the rift. Over the following years, Obed grew deeply attached to Nell, frequently delighting her with small treats like sweeties and buying her a stylish new dress. When the Abbey Bank failed, Obed suffered a fatal heart attack upon reading the news and collapsed at Grey Shutters, passing away surrounded by the traditional garden flowers he loved.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c3 P62](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0062), [v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030), [v1 c10 P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 c10 P19](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0019), [v1 c12 P43](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0043), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P33](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0033), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P2](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0002), [v1 c37 P8](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0008), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Background by volume

- Raised in a sprawling farmstead built by his bashful father on the outer border of cleared property in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Wore a thick brown beard continually starting at the age of twenty  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Suffered from long-standing heart trouble  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c36 P28](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0028)</sub>
- Resided at Grey Shutters alongside his unmarried sister Thirza into his adulthood  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
